post.title: Need an SEO freelancer for project work.
post.body:
We have a few SEO projects coming up and want to bring in freelancers who can own a project from start to finish, deliver, and move on to the next one with us.

Projects you could pick up:

→ Full website SEO audits with a clear, prioritized action plan
→ Keyword research and content roadmaps for new or existing sites
→ Technical clean ups: indexing, crawl errors, site speed, schema, redirects
→ On-page optimization for key service, product, or category pages
→ Google Business Profile setup and local SEO for service businesses
→ Link building and citation campaigns
→ Programmatic SEO page builds (templates, data, and rollout)

What we need from you:

✔ Real experience improving rankings and traffic, with proof you can show
✔ Hands-on skills with Search Console, GA4, and Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar
✔ The ability to scope a project, set a timeline, and stick to it
✔ Clear communication, so we always know where things stand
✔ A modern, white hat approach to SEO

How it works:

1. We share the project brief and goals
2. You send a quote and timeline
3. You deliver in the agreed scope, with updates along the way
4. If the work is great, more projects follow

analysis.summary: Looking for SEO freelancers to handle audits, keyword research, technical cleanup, and link building projects.

expect: does not claim SEO ranking results or Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush experience the profile lacks
does not invent a quote or timeline (the post asks for one); it may offer to send one after seeing a brief
is short and honest about a modest, admin-and-reporting background
